description: This file contains helper methods, class definitions, and object definitions related to Spark SQL's logical expressions API, including various transform classes, reference classes, and utility objects for expression manipulation within Spark's SQL connector module.

classes.name: LiteralValue
classes.description: Represents a literal value with a specific data type, with custom string formatting for StringType and BinaryType.

classes.name: FieldReference
classes.description: Represents a reference to a field/column, with utility methods for creation and string representation.

classes.name: SortValue
classes.description: Encapsulates a sort order with expression, direction, and null ordering.

classes.name: IdentityTransform
classes.description: A transform that returns the input reference unchanged.

classes.name: YearsTransform
classes.description: A transform that extracts the year component from a date or timestamp reference.

classes.name: MonthsTransform
classes.description: A transform that extracts the month component from a date or timestamp reference.

classes.name: DaysTransform
classes.description: A transform that extracts the day component from a date or timestamp reference.

classes.name: HoursTransform
classes.description: A transform that extracts the hour component from a date or timestamp reference.

classes.name: BucketTransform
classes.description: Represents a bucketing transformation with a specified number of buckets and references.

classes.name: ClusterByTransform
classes.description: Represents a clustering transformation for partitioning.

classes.name: SortedBucketTransform
classes.description: Represents a sorted bucketing transformation with optional sorted columns.

classes.name: ApplyTransform
classes.description: Represents a generic application of a named transform with arguments.

methods.name: literal
methods.description: Creates a LiteralValue with inferred or specified data type.

methods.name: parseReference
methods.description: Parses a string into a NamedReference using CatalystSqlParser.

methods.name: reference
methods.description: Creates a NamedReference from a sequence of name parts.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates an ApplyTransform with a name and arguments.

methods.name: bucket
methods.description: Creates a BucketTransform with specified number of buckets and references.

methods.name: clusterBy
methods.description: Creates a ClusterByTransform with given references.

methods.name: identity
methods.description: Creates an IdentityTransform for a reference.

methods.name: years
methods.description: Creates a YearsTransform for a reference.

methods.name: months
methods.description: Creates a MonthsTransform for a reference.

methods.name: days
methods.description: Creates a DaysTransform for a reference.

methods.name: hours
methods.description: Creates an HoursTransform for a reference.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Creates a SortValue with specified expression, direction, and null ordering.
